title: I had a wonderful time....
text: I had a wonderful time. Absolutely friendly and accommodating people. No background in painting at all but was guided through step by step.
author: Suriabaanu_R

title: Barcelona painting and vermut experience
text:
I had the best time at this workshop. I’m
Not in the least bit artistic, but the teacher guided us so well, that I surprised myself!!!!! I came home with an amazing memorabilia of BCN, that of a painted skyline 😁The vermouth and the nibbles were delicious too. Such a fun evening, I highly recommend it 🔝🔝🔝

title: Amazing experience/plan !
text: Such an amazing experience!! Me and my work team went to do this after work plan and it was so fun. We got to take our paintings home which I thought it was awesome. Need to mention that awesome Vermouth that they created.. called “consul”. Thanks for everything. I’ll definitely repeat. See you soon!!
author: Helena L

title: Entertaining and fun!
text: We loved it! The academy is colorful and welcoming, the staff very friendly. We painted Van Gogh's Starry Night and against our expectations the result was actually amazing! Maybe it was the vermouth, but more likely   it was thanks to Mike, the young and lovely teacher. Totally recommended!
author: Brujiki
